result.title: M3Former: Fine-Grained Cross-Layer Mixing for Transformers
result.summary: Residual connections give each Transformer block access to all earlier layers only through one fixed sum, broadcast to all of the block's inputs. This broadcast bottleneck imposes three constraints: the query, key, value and residual inputs of a block, which we call its roles, read the same vector; all hidden dimensions within a role share one set of weights over earlier layers; and every earlier layer has the same fixed weight for every token. We propose the Multi-Role Multi-Group Mixing Residual (M3), which removes all three: every role, and every group of hidden dimensions within a role, reads its own token-dependent mixture of all earlier layers. M3 starts as an exact residual connection and adds as little as 1.4% parameters and 1.8% FLOPs. From 100M to 1.4B parameters, M3Former outperforms the Transformer and coarse-grained cross-layer connections at every size, matching a Transformer 1.19-1.34x the size of the one it modifies, trained with 1.4-1.8x the compute. Relaxing only some of the constraints recovers only part of this gain. M3Former also improves sparse mixture-of-experts models of up to 4.6B parameters and trains more stably in deeper networks. Code: https://github.com/Kingchet10/m3former

AI.brief_summary: 提出 M3 残差结构：让 Transformer 每个 block 的 query/key/value/残差等「角色」以及角色内的隐藏维分组，各自读取对全部早期层的、随 token 变化的混合权重，仅增加约 1.4% 参数与 1.8% FLOPs；在 100M–1.4B 规模、以及最多 4.6B 的 MoE 模型上均优于普通 Transformer 和粗粒度跨层连接。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯语言模型架构工作，未涉及视觉或多模态推理；但其 token 相关的跨层混合权重可供核查 latent 推理状态在深度方向上如何聚合与更新（对应 latent 表示中深度、位置因素的分析），属于待验证的方法线索。
